name: rtbrick-mcp-server
description: Search and read RTBrick RBFS technical documentation (recent release lines) and training modules from your AI assistant. No API key required.

environmentVariables.name: RTBRICK_MCP_MAX_VERSIONS
environmentVariables.description: How many recent RBFS release lines to offer; the newest patch of each is used. Default: 5.

environmentVariables.name: RTBRICK_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for cached pages, or 'off'. Default: ~/.cache/rtbrick-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: RTBRICK_MCP_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: How long cached pages of the current release stay fresh. Default: 24.

environmentVariables.name: RTBRICK_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging verbosity (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR). Default: INFO.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search RBFS technical documentation and training modules; returns matching sections with direct links.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Read a documentation or training page, or a single section of it, for any available version.

tools.name: list_doc_versions
tools.description: List the available tech-docs versions (newest patch of each recent release line) and the training version.

tools.name: list_doc_pages
tools.description: List the pages of the tech docs or training material, grouped by guide.

tools.name: fetch_rtbrick_page
tools.description: Read any page on www.rtbrick.com as text.
